# codencode.sg

> codencode.sg is a Singapore online coding and AI academy. It runs live, instructor-led Zoom courses in Python, cybersecurity, machine learning and vibe coding, plus half-day in-person AI workshops in Singapore. Classes are taught in English, Mandarin (中文) and Bahasa Melayu, with Tamil-speaking support. First class is free.

Last updated: 2026-10-22

## Contact & enrolment
- WhatsApp (primary channel, fastest response): https://wa.me/6583216288
- Phone: +65 8321 6288
- Area served: all of Singapore (online courses); in-person workshops in Singapore, venue details via WhatsApp
- There is no web sign-up form — enquiries and enrolment are by WhatsApp.

## Courses (live online via Zoom)
- Python Fundamentals — 6 weeks + 1 week project, beginner. Automating spreadsheets, web scraping, data analysis.
- Cybersecurity Fundamentals — 6 weeks + 1 week project, beginner. Phishing, password hygiene, network basics, intro pentesting.
- Machine Learning Fundamentals — 10 weeks, intermediate (some Python needed). Train real models, portfolio projects.
- Vibe Coding — 4 weeks, beginner. Build apps with AI tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Claude.
- Every session is recorded and uploaded within 24 hours. First class is free.

## AI for ___ Workshops (in person, half-day, 4 hours)
- AI for Workplace, AI for Marketing, AI for Event Management, AI for HR, AI for Accounting.
- One-off, fixed-format sessions in Singapore — not enrolled multi-week courses.
